title: Consumer Protection — Labeling Essentials (sample RusLawOD-style)
text: Sample regulatory abstract for retail: food labels must indicate composition and allergens in a clear manner. Retailers are responsible for accurate on-shelf information derived from manufacturer labeling. Source corpus: RusLawOD-style NPA excerpt for demo (not official consolidation).

title: Personal Data in Retail Loyalty — Sample Act Abstract
text: Sample regulatory guidance for retail loyalty programs: personal data processing requires lawful basis, minimization, and security measures. Knowledge assistants must not echo raw customer identifiers in answers.
